settings.text:
WE TURN YOUR FLOWER DREAMS INTO REALITY

From the very beginning, we make it a priority to understand your unique style, story, and vibe. Through virtual meetings and personalised mood boards, we collaborate closely with you to create a vision that truly reflects your personality and your love story.

It’s a bit like curating your own Pinterest board, but instead of just dreaming, we’re turning those beautiful ideas into reality for your big day! We’re here to make sure every detail feels authentic to you and your journey together.

A timeline of our process:

  • Virtual (or in-person) meeting to dive deep into your ideas and aspirations. We can fine-tune details as we go.
  • We'll create a beautiful, interactive proposal with extensive mood boards that captures the feeling and vision you want to create for your wedding day.
  • Once you are happy with the proposal and want to secure our services, we ask for a 15% deposit and signatures; our agreement means we are yours for the day!
  • Along the way, we will keep connected, share ideas and make amendments as necessary.
  • 12 weeks out we will touch base to confirm all the finer details and requirements.
  • 10 weeks out Final payment is made and we will finalise our flower orders with our growers and suppliers to secure you the best blooms for your wedding day.
  • On the BIG day - we’ll bring to life everything on your proposal; from ceremony backdrops to table settings and hanging installations; your vision will become a reality and there will be plenty of “Ohh’s and ahh’s” and “WOW! Who did your flowers!” from your guests.
  • The next day we will come to pack down and if you’d like to keep any of your flowers, we can save the best blooms to deliver to you or to donate to schools or retirement homes.
  • Your love story and vision will be captured on film and we would LOVE to see these incredible pictures and share them with our flower-loving community.

Our Promise To You

Only the highest-quality vendors get recommended by us. These are teams we know, trust, and adore!

STYLED DETAILS THAT BRING IT ALL TOGETHER

It’s the small things that make the biggest impact. From custom signage to table settings, we ensure that every detail is thoughtfully planned and executed. Our styling goes beyond flowers to cover every little thing that will leave your guests saying, "Wow!"

What We Do:

  • Source unique decorative pieces and rentals (hello, scallop edged napkins, disco balls and mirrored signage)
  • Full setup and styling on the day, from the ceremony space to the reception.
  • Styling elements that connect the entire experience, from guest welcome areas to reception tables and even those “Instagrammable” moments.

Why It Matters

You get to walk into your venue knowing it looks exactly like what you imagined—even better. We handle the heavy lifting so your wedding is flawless from start to finish.

SUSTAINABLE &
THOUGHTFUL CHOICES

We’re making big changes around here! We are all about creating beauty with minimal impact on thr earth. All our services incorporate sustainable practices and reusable options to ensure that your wedding is as eco-friendly as it is breathtaking.

What We Do:

  • Foam-free designs and eco-conscious arrangements with biodegradable materials.
  • Support local growers for fresh, seasonal flowers and plants.
  • Repurpose floral installations from ceremony to reception, extending their beauty throughout the day.
  • Zero plastic wrap and all plant-based packaging options for a green celebration.
Stress less, celebrate more—leave the details to us!
Quality Blooms: Locally sourced and carefully selected for each event.
Creativity & Craftsmanship: Bold designs that reflect your vision and personality.
Systems & processes for a stress-free experience - We’re committed to clarity so you know where you're at throughout the journey.

settings.question: Where do you source your flowers?
settings.answear: We source our flowers locally whenever possible, from November to April (weather permitting). Our commitment to local flowers means fresher blooms and support for our community.

settings.question: What if I have a specific flower in mind for my wedding?
settings.answear: At The Green Room, we focus on seasonality and use popular wedding flowers like peonies, roses and hydrangeas when they're in season. If you have a strong preference, we’re happy to discuss options, but we recommend choosing a colour palette and vibe rather than specific flowers, allowing us to create arrangements that are both beautiful and seasonally available.

settings.question: Can I repurpose my wedding flowers for other parts of the day?
settings.answear: Absolutely! Repurposing your flowers is a cost-effective and sustainable way to make the most of your floral investment. We can help restyle your arrangements for different parts of your celebration, so you can spend more time with loved ones while maximizing your floral budget.

settings.question: What can we do with the flowers after the wedding?
settings.answear:
You have several options for giving your flowers a second life! You can:

  • DIY arrangements with leftover blooms.
  • Have our team come back to refresh and turn them into mini bouquets for guests or loved ones.
  • Arrange a floral drop-off for your recovery day or after-party.
  • Donate them to a kindergarten, retirement home, or a cause you care about.
  • Preserve a few blooms through Botanic Press for a keepsake frame! Use code GREENROOM25 for $25 off

settings.question: Why is the booking deposit non-refundable?
settings.answear: Your booking deposit reserves your wedding date exclusively with us, meaning we often turn down other events for that day. This commitment helps us focus fully on your wedding, ensuring our best work.

settings.question: What if I need to change my wedding date?
settings.answear: We understand plans can change. If you need to change your date, a one-time amendment fee of $150 + GST will apply to cover administrative costs. If the change is made within 12 months of your original date, additional fees may apply.

settings.question: What happens if I cancel my booking?
settings.answear:
• More than 6 months out: The booking fee is non-refundable as we've reserved the date for you and may have turned down other bookings.
  • Less than 3 months out: We may refund 25% of other payments made (minus any incurred costs) at our discretion, but the booking fee and service fee are non-refundable.
